verdict.rationale: Bitbucket docs mention built-in AI capabilities: an AI code reviewer that reviews changes and suggests fixes, AI-powered pipeline workflows to automate tasks (feature flag cleanup, docs updates, release notes, flaky test fixes), and access to Rovo AI assistant in terminal/IDE. These support delegating tasks to a built-in AI assistant, but the story's depth (e.g., detailed task delegation UX, chat-based commands) isn't well documented and there is no independent/hands-on corroboration of these AI features actually working. Missing for 10: independent verification of AI assistant behavior, deeper documentation of delegation workflow, and community evidence confirming real-world use.
